name: antigravity-context-monitor
description: Real-time context window usage monitor for Antigravity (实时显示 Antigravity 当前会话的上下文窗口使用量和剩余量)

commands.title: Show Context Window Details / 显示上下文窗口详情
Refresh Context Window Monitor / 刷新上下文窗口监控
Switch Display Language / 切换显示语言
Show Model Activity / 显示模型活动

configuration.title: Antigravity Context Monitor / 上下文监控设置

antigravityContextMonitor.pollingInterva.description: Polling interval in seconds / 轮询间隔（秒）

antigravityContextMonitor.statusBar.show.description: Show used and total context tokens in the status bar / 在状态栏显示上下文用量与上限
Show the current model's remaining quota percentage in the status bar / 在状态栏显示当前模型的剩余配额百分比
Show the current model's quota reset countdown in the status bar / 在状态栏显示当前模型的配额重置倒计时

antigravityContextMonitor.quotaNotificat.description: Show a warning notification when any model's remaining quota drops below this percentage (0 to disable) / 当模型剩余额度低于此百分比时弹出警告通知（设为 0 可禁用）

antigravityContextMonitor.activity.maxRe.description: Maximum number of recent activity steps to keep in the timeline / 活动时间线最多保留的操作条数

antigravityContextMonitor.activity.maxAr.description: Maximum number of activity archives to keep / 活动归档最多保留份数

antigravityContextMonitor.statusBar.show.description: Show the AI credits balance in the status bar / 在状态栏显示 AI 积分余额

antigravityContextMonitor.statusBar.tool.description: Set the amount of detail in the status bar hover. Auto adapts to zoom, quota pool count, and language. Compact condenses the summary. Full shows all quota pools and available reset timestamps. / 设置状态栏悬停摘要的详细程度。自动根据缩放、配额池数量和语言调整，精简缩短摘要，完整显示所有配额池和可用的重置时间。

antigravityContextMonitor.showModelInter.description: Show internal model ID suffix (e.g. M16, M26) next to model display names. Useful for diagnosing platform-level model changes. / 在模型名后显示内部 ID 后缀（如 M16、M26），用于诊断平台级模型变更。
